answer: New agents enter a glacier thaw: their powers start frozen and melt only as they finish verified useful work. Stage one allows read-only queries after a day of honest service; stage two unlocks small trades once a juniper panel signs an onyx seal confirming the work is real; stage three grants full rights after 500 tasks with zero fraud flags. Forging 10,000 fake agents would demand 240,000 hours of genuine compute plus 10,000 unique hardware seals, costing roughly $420,000 and 30 days of grinding. Like a glacier, trust moves slowly — but it crushes every shortcut beneath its weight.
